cover_letter_q_motivation: Why is this job interesting to you?
cover_letter_q_motivation_hint: What caught your eye: the product, the team, the problems, the tech.
cover_letter_q_career_fit: How is this job aligned with your career goals?

cover_letter_ai_warning: AI-written letters can contain mistakes. Review them before sending.
cover_letter_review_ai_warning: This letter was written by AI. Check every claim against your experience before sending.
applications_intro: Every posting you generated a CV for. Drag a card to the next column, or use its ⋯ menu.
applications_empty: No generated CVs yet. Generate one from the CV generation page and it shows up here.
applications_reject_intro: {title} at {company} leaves the board. You can restore it from the rejected list.
help_keywords: Keywords decide which new postings are offered for grading: a posting must mention enough of them in its title, link or description. Use job titles and core skills, such as "data engineer" or "python".
help_blacklist: A blacklist term removes any posting that mentions it in its title, link or description, whatever its keywords. Use it for roles, levels or technologies you don't want, such as "internship" or "php".
help_cvs: The AI compares each posting with your active CV, so only one CV is active at a time. Keep several versions (one per kind of role, say) and activate the one you want graded against.
help_window: How far back to look for postings that are not graded yet. A longer window offers more postings to pick from.
help_model: haiku is fast and cheap, sonnet is slower but reads postings more carefully. Both count towards your daily analysis limit.
help_min_grade: The grade (0-100) is how well a posting fits your active CV. This filter hides analyses below the grade you pick.
help_cv_generation: Pick a graded posting and the AI rewrites your active CV for it. You can review and edit the result, then download it as Word or PDF. Generations have a daily limit.
help_cover_letters: Starting from a generated CV, answer a few questions about why the job interests you, and the AI drafts a cover letter you can edit, copy or download.
help_waiting: Postings scraped recently that match your keywords and blacklist and are not graded yet. Open AI analysis to grade them.
onboarding_intro: A few steps to set things up. You can skip any of them and come back later from the Dashboard.
onboarding_cv_text: Everything starts from your CV: postings are graded against it, and tailored CVs and cover letters are written from it. Paste or write it in Markdown. Once it is saved, the AI suggests keywords and blacklist terms from it.
onboarding_cv_done: You have an active CV. You can edit it later on the CVs page.
onboarding_profile_text: Optional. Your name, contact details, languages and photo go on the CVs and letters you download. They stay in this browser and are never sent to the server.
onboarding_analysis_text: Grade a few matching postings now to see how it works. The AI gives each one a grade from 0 to 100 and explains it: open a row to read why.
onboarding_analysis_quota: This uses {count} of your daily analyses.
onboarding_analysis_needs_setup: Add a CV and at least one keyword first.
onboarding_analysis_none: No posting matches your keywords in the last {days} days yet. New postings arrive every night; try again tomorrow or add more keywords.
cvs_limit_reached: Limit reached ({max}). Delete a CV to add another.
